root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `isNumeric()` may read `chartype_table[static_cast<size_t>(in)]`, it must prove `static_cast<size_t>(in) < sizeof(chartype_table)`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The selected root obligation is the missing bounds check around the 256-byte character-class table. On the crashing original call, the first name byte is signed `-128`, so `static_cast<size_t>(in)` becomes `18446744073709551488` and the vulnerable program still executes the table read.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original violates the frozen predicate while the protected table-read event executes. The fixed original reaches the same guard site on the `-128` name byte but suppresses the protected table lookup there, and the adjacent `name_byte_0x7f` perturbation supplies the genuine witness where the predicate is true and the guarded lookup executes with index `127`.

nodes.state: At the selected `chartype_table` read, the lookup index is not within the 256-entry table. On the crashing original, `lookup_index == 18446744073709551488` while `chartype_table_size == 256`.
At the leading-digit rejection check in `parseIdentifier()`, the signed first identifier byte is the same source value later passed to `isNumeric()` as its lookup argument.

edges.relation: When the vulnerable program proceeds past the missing bounds obligation, the same computed lookup index measured at the guard site is the index used at the `chartype_table` read.
The first identifier byte observed at `parseIdentifier()` is passed unchanged into `isNumeric()`, where that same signed `char` value becomes the lookup argument whose bounds must be checked.
